_comment: Rule V4 — framework/DPS notice flag. A notice is is_framework if ANY component fires: (1) eForms indicator fields (BT-765 framework-agreement-lot/part not 'none', BT-766 dps-usage-lot/part not 'none', legacy contract-framework-agreement true) — authoritative when present (eForms, from 2023-10-25); (2) title keyword (multilingual, accent-folded substring match, lowercase except entries in acronyms_case_sensitive which need the exact case as standalone word); (3) buyer is a central purchasing body (folded-lowercase substring of buyer name; CPBs procure via frameworks/DPS by design); (4) the same amount>=repeat_amount_min_eurlike with the same currency appears under >=repeat_min_publications distinct publication numbers in the same country (framework republication signature, e.g. SKI 02.14 DKK 89.3bn x4). Components 2-4 are the heuristic fallback for pre-eForms notices.
central_purchasing_buyers_folded_lower: azienda regionale per l'innovazione e gli acquisti
